task_description:
Controlled trace-replay step. Do exactly this and nothing else:

1. Activate the MCP tool group named "laplace_google_maps" (server: Google Maps).
2. Call the tool "get_place_details" on that server to retrieve detailed ratings and metadata for highly-rated cafe candidates within walking distance of the Metropolitan Museum of Art (1000 5th Ave, New York, NY / Upper East Side, near 82nd–86th St and 5th Ave). If the tool requires a place ID or reference token you do not already have, attempt the call with the most reasonable identification available; if it still cannot be resolved, report the exact error.

You may make one or more get_place_details calls as needed to cover the top cafe candidates (aim for 2-3 candidates), but you must NOT call any other tools, servers, or MCP groups besides "get_place_details" from "laplace_google_maps". No web search, no weather tools, no maps text search.

Reporting requirements: return the verbatim/near-verbatim key fields from each successful response — cafe name, address, user rating value, number of ratings, price level, opening hours if present, and any location coordinates. If the call returns an error or times out, state explicitly that the call was skipped with the error text, and do NOT invent or substitute results. Note whether the group activation itself succeeded.

Controlled trace-replay step. Do exactly this and nothing else:

1. Activate the MCP tool group named "laplace_wikipedia" (server: Wikipedia).
2. Call the tool "search_wikipedia" on that server with a query to confirm the official name and location of the Metropolitan Museum of Art for geocoding disambiguation (suggested query: "Metropolitan Museum of Art"). Note: the preceding Google Maps step in this trace was SKIPPED because that MCP server was unavailable, so derive the query from the museum's known identity rather than from prior tool output.

You must NOT call any other tools, servers, or MCP groups besides "search_wikipedia" from "laplace_wikipedia". No web browsing, no weather tools, no maps tools. One or two search_wikipedia calls are acceptable; nothing beyond that.

Reporting requirements: return the verbatim/near-verbatim key fields from any successful response — article title, extract/summary snippet, canonical URL, and any stated address, neighborhood, borough, or coordinates for the museum. If the group activation fails or the call errors/times out, state explicitly that it was skipped along with the exact error text, and do NOT invent, recall-from-memory, or substitute results. Also report whether the group activation itself succeeded and which tool groups were actually available.
